SELECT COALESCE(om.out_order_no, om.order_no, CAST(om.order_id AS CHAR)) AS orderId, CASE WHEN om.guest_mobile IS NULL OR om.guest_mobile = '' THEN om.guest_name ELSE CONCAT(om.guest_name, ' / ', om.guest_mobile) END AS customerInfo, CASE WHEN gm.goods_type = 'coupon' THEN '预售券' WHEN gm.goods_type = 'package' THEN '套餐' WHEN gm.goods_type = 'service' THEN '服务' WHEN om.order_type = 'hourly_room' THEN '钟点房' WHEN om.order_type = 'daily_room' THEN '日租房' ELSE '品牌小程序' END AS productType, COALESCE(gm.name, rc.name, om.order_type) AS productName, DATE_FORMAT(om.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS bookingTime, CASE WHEN om.source_type = 'mall' THEN '品牌小程序' WHEN om.source_type = 'frontdesk' THEN '前台' WHEN om.source_type = 'phone' THEN '电话' WHEN om.source_type = 'channel' THEN 'OTA' ELSE '其他' END AS channelName, COALESCE(om.total_price_cent, 0) AS payableAmountCent, COALESCE(om.total_pay_price_cent, 0) AS paidAmountCent, COALESCE(om.discount_price_cent, 0) AS discountAmountCent, COALESCE(om.refund_price_cent, 0) AS refundAmountCent, COALESCE(om.payment_fee_cent, 0) AS paymentFeeCent, COALESCE(om.platform_service_fee_cent, 0) AS platformServiceFeeCent, COALESCE(om.distribution_commission_cent, om.commission_price_cent, 0) AS distributorCommissionCent, COALESCE(pw.payment_way_name, '') AS paymentWayName, COALESCE(om.settlement_amount_cent, 0) AS settlementAmountCent FROM order_main om LEFT JOIN goods_main gm ON gm.goods_id = om.goods_id AND gm.camp_id = om.camp_id AND gm.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = om.room_category_id LEFT JOIN payment_way pw ON pw.payment_way_id = om.payment_way_id AND pw.camp_id = om.camp_id AND pw.is_deleted = 0
ORDER BY om.created_at ASC, om.order_id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
